notes: Results compared were generated by ArXivist's own self-check run of the repository (no external user-supplied results were available), using full configs/config.yaml scale (n_accuracy_blocks=8) but a single-seed, single-restart optimisation and closed-form (infinite-shot) evaluation rather than shot-sampled circuit execution.
3 of 9 paper metrics (all requiring live ibm_fez hardware access) could not be matched in this run.
reproducibility_score=0.0 reflects the max(0, ...) floor being reached; underlying base_score before penalties was 0.1064.

score_confidence is 'medium' rather than 'high' despite 6/9 metrics matching (>=3 threshold) because the training protocol used differs materially from the paper's (see benchmark_comparison.md root cause analysis: different optimizer for the Gaussian case, no shot noise, single-restart L-BFGS-B for Black-Scholes).
